summary: The Solar System (also called the Outer Wilds) contains almost every location in the game: a yellow-dwarf Sun, five planets, multiple moons, and several artificial satellites. From the beginning of every loop, the player has 22 minutes before the Sun goes supernova and destroys the system.

biology: The Sun at the center of the Solar System is a yellow-dwarf, main-sequence star.
All other astronomical bodies in the Solar System orbit the Sun.
behavior: Every time loop lasts 22 minutes from the start of the cycle until the Sun goes supernova.
As the loop progresses, the Sun grows into a Red Giant before collapsing into a supernova.
The Red Giant grows large enough to overlap the Interloper's orbit, destroying the Interloper before the supernova.
location: The Solar System contains five planets: the Hourglass Twins (Ash Twin + Ember Twin), Timber Hearth, Brittle Hollow, Giant's Deep, and Dark Bramble.
Timber Hearth has one moon, the Attlerock.
Brittle Hollow has one moon, Hollow's Lantern.
The Quantum Moon is a wandering moon that appears in orbit around different planets and the Eye of the Universe.
The Interloper is an extra-solar comet on a highly elliptical orbit, with a perihelion lower than the Hourglass Twins and an aphelion further out than the White Hole Station.
The White Hole is a gravitational singularity on the system's outskirts, linked to the black hole at the core of Brittle Hollow.
The Eye of the Universe is a distant mysterious object in a far orbit around the Sun.
The player can journey to any location from their first expedition into space.
lore: The Ash Twin / Ember Twin binary transfers sand between the two planets over the course of the loop.
Sand transfer uncovers buried Nomai architecture on Ash Twin while filling Ember Twin's caves and making them inaccessible.
Brittle Hollow's moon Hollow's Lantern bombards the planet with meteors that break off chunks of the crust, which fall through the central black hole.
Fragments that fall through Brittle Hollow's black hole emerge from the White Hole on the system's outskirts.
Dark Bramble was originally an ocean planet before being infected with twisted vines that tore the planet apart.
The Interloper can be seen crashing into the Sun when the loop nears its end.
The Sun Station is a Nomai station in very low heliocentric orbit, tidally locked to the Sun and generally inaccessible by ship.
The Sun Station is absorbed and destroyed by the Sun's growing outer layer as it becomes a Red Giant.
The Orbital Probe Cannon is a Nomai artificial satellite in orbit around Giant's Deep that launches a probe and immediately explodes at the start of every loop.
Fragments of the Orbital Probe Cannon continue to orbit Giant's Deep for the duration of the loop.
The White Hole Station is a Nomai space station built beside the White Hole to warp users back to Brittle Hollow after falling through the black hole.
The Hearthian Satellite orbits Timber Hearth and allows grainy black-and-white pictures to be taken remotely on Timber Hearth.
The Hearthian Satellite can be de-orbited to grant an achievement.
The Deep Space Satellite is a Hearthian probe in an extremely high polar orbit around the Sun, among the farthest objects from the Sun in the system.
The Deep Space Satellite is connected to Timber Hearth's radio tower and provides a real-time map of the Solar System.
The Stranger is a giant cloaked spaceship built by an unnamed species that came before the Nomai.
The Stranger uses centrifugal force in a ring shape to simulate gravity and is built for long-duration interstellar travel.
The Stranger has a fixed position initially and moves away from the Sun to avoid the supernova at the end of every loop.
